career_ladder.note: Cadre progression for ministerial, clerical, and subordinate staff in the Administration of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep is governed by the Central Civil Services rules and Union Territory of Lakshadweep recruitment regulations. For the clerical stream, entry is as Lower Division Clerk (LDC) / Junior Assistant at Pay Level 2 (₹19,900 - ₹63,200), advancing after 8 years of regular service and passing the departmental tests for ministerial staff conducted by the Lakshadweep Administration to Upper Division Clerk / Head Clerk (Pay Level 4, ₹25,500 - ₹81,100). Higher promotional avenues lead to Assistant / Sheristadar (Pay Level 6, ₹35,400 - ₹1,12,400) and Section Officer / Office Superintendent (Pay Level 7, ₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400), with senior administrative advancements to Assistant Secretary / Under Secretary (Pay Level 10, ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500) in the Secretariat cadre. In the executive police cadre, entry is as Police Constable (Executive) at Pay Level 3 (₹21,700 - ₹69,100), advancing to Head Constable (Pay Level 4), Assistant Sub-Inspector (Pay Level 5), and Sub-Inspector (Pay Level 6).

exam_scheme.note: The Staff Selection Examination conducted by the Administration of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep (Secretariat Services Department / Departmental Selection Boards) for Group 'C' posts (such as Lower Division Clerks, Typists, and Junior Assistants) follows a standard two-stage recruitment process. Stage 1 is an Objective Written Competitive Examination (OMR / Computer Based) consisting of 100 multiple-choice questions for 100 marks (or 200 questions for 200 marks) lasting 120 minutes (2 hours). The examination is bilingual in English and Malayalam / Hindi (with the General English section in English only). There is negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer. Candidates qualifying the written examination in order of merit are summoned for Stage 2, which is a qualifying Computer Typing / Skill Test (minimum 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi/Malayalam on computer), followed by Stage 3 Document Verification and Medical Examination.

financial_package.note: Lakshadweep is a Union Territory directly administered by the Central Government (Ministry of Home Affairs); administration employees are Central Civil Services personnel governed by the Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix. The foundational clerical entry post of Lower Division Clerk (LDC) is positioned at Pay Level 2 (entry basic pay ₹19,900; scale ₹19,900 - ₹63,200). Entry-level Police Constables and Patwaris are positioned at Pay Level 3 (entry basic pay ₹21,700; scale ₹21,700 - ₹69,100), and Head Clerks / UDCs are positioned at Pay Level 4 (entry basic pay ₹25,500; scale ₹25,500 - ₹81,100). In addition to 58% Central DA and standard allowances, personnel stationed in the Lakshadweep archipelago are entitled to the Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) under Ministry of Finance Department of Expenditure orders (typically 12.5% to 20% of Basic Pay depending on the island zone) to compensate for maritime isolation and remote island conditions.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level 2 (Lower Division Clerk) at Entry Basic Pay of ₹19,900 with DA at 58% (₹11,542). Includes House Rent Allowance (9% / ₹1,791 for Class Z island towns, or government residential accommodation), Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + DA ₹783 = ₹2,133, or local island conveyance), and Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) at 12.5% (₹2,488) to 20% (₹3,980) of Basic Pay depending on island posting zone. Deductions include mandatory NPS employee contribution (10% of Basic + DA = ₹3,144) and CGEGIS insurance, yielding estimated in-hand pay of ₹32,000 to ₹36,500. (For Level 3 Police Constable at basic ₹21,700, estimated in-hand is ₹34,500 - ₹39,500; for Level 4 Head Clerk at basic ₹25,500, estimated in-hand is ₹39,000 - ₹45,500).
official_perks: Island Special Duty Allowance (ISDA) of 12.5% to 20% of Basic Pay depending on island posting zone
Government residential accommodation in Kavaratti or island stations, or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Transport Allowance (TPTA) with Dearness Allowance or local island conveyance

Island Leave Travel Concession (Island LTC) including subsidized passenger ship passage (all-weather ships) and helicopter / flight travel between Cochin/Kozhikode and Lakshadweep per Central Government Island LTC orders

Defined contribution pension under the National Pension System (NPS) with 14% Central Government employer contribution

competition_benchmarks.note: In the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, total population across the 10 inhabited coral islands is approximately 65,000 to 70,000 (2011 Census: 64,473), with more than 95% of the indigenous population belonging to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. A substantial portion of Group 'C' subordinate and clerical vacancies are earmarked for local native islanders registered with the District Employment Exchange, Kavaratti. In the revised 2026 cadre review published in Lakshadweep Gazette Vol. LXII No. 38, the sanctioned strength of the Police Constable (Executive) cadre was established at 224 posts (with 33% horizontal reservation for women). Centralized administrative clerical drives for LDCs, Village Dweep Sevaks, and subordinate personnel typically notify batches of 30 to 90 vacancies, drawing approximately 2,500 to 4,500 registered island applicants with competitive selection ratios ranging from 1 in 35 to 1 in 60.
